- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:488-513 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `last_cycle_baseline_sha` reads only the first page of issue comments (`comments?per_page=100`, with no pagination) and takes the `last` marker on that page, so a newer baseline marker after comment 100 is missed and an older marker's SHA and timestamp are returned.
  WHY: This PR adds a new user of that timestamp: the `with_time` value feeds the cycle_stale clock in `release_blocker_check_cycle_stale` (lines 1488/1497-1503 on the path before guard 4, line 1621 at guard 4). On a busy tracking issue the age comes out too high, which sends a false `cycle_stale` heal report and can open a spurious workflow-heal issue. It also points guard 4's "same tip" check at an older SHA. All four reviewers who flagged it rated it MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disagreed and did not report it: the single-page read predates this PR, the loop stops at the first trusted marker, and that marker sits near the start of the tracking issue.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:507-513; the timestamp is used by `release_blocker_check_cycle_stale` at 1497-1503. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The baseline lookup reads one page of up to 100 comments and picks the last matching marker on that page. It never fetches later pages to find the newest trusted baseline marker.
  WHY: If a recent marker is on a later page, the stale reporter uses an older timestamp. When the unreleased commit is also old enough, it reports `cycle_stale` even though the recent marker reset the clock.

  PROBLEM: Only the first page is fetched (oldest-first, no `--paginate`, no `since`), so an older marker's SHA and timestamp are returned. The PR adds a new user of that timestamp (line 1488 before guard 4, line 1621 at guard 4). Other scripts paginate this same read (`scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:1254`, `scripts/unblock_judge.sh:167`).
  WHY: When a baseline marker lands past comment 100, the next skipped tick computes an inflated age and sends a false `cycle_stale` heal report, which opens a spurious workflow-heal issue. Guard 4's "same tip" check is also weakened to an older SHA.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
